narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Three and four make seven, so the pencil is seven tenths.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But the pencil is longer than three whole units, and seven tenths is shorter than one.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Three units are not three tenths. A unit is ten tenths.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To count in tenths, multiply the units by ten and add the tenths.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. A bean pod is two units and five tenths long. Write its length as a count of tenths.
